objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the login form evaluate an OGNL expression, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Submit the form with an empty field and look at how the value is redisplayed. Read the S2-001 advisory on altSyntax evaluation.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Java web framework handles the form? (name only)

steps.title: Name the advisory
steps.prompt: Which Struts security bulletin covers this bug?

steps.title: Find the trigger
steps.prompt: What must happen to the form submission for the field value to be re-evaluated? (two words)

steps.title: Name the language
steps.prompt: Which expression language evaluates the field value? (acronym)
